text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Run release-plz
        uses: release-plz/release-plz-action@v0.5.0
        with:
          command: release
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
